title: MSI RX 480 Gaming X Review & Benchmark
description:
Our definitive review of MSI's RX 480 Gaming X graphics card, including specs, FPS performance analysis, extensive thermal testing, and overclocking. We test the RX 480 Gaming X vs. the reference card, GTX 1060s, and about a dozen other GPUs.

Full review! http://www.gamersnexus.net/hwreviews/2541-msi-rx-480-gaming-x-review-and-benchmark-vs-1060
